# Dorian Award for Outstanding Off-Broadway Production

}}
The Dorian Award for Outstanding Off-Broadway Production is one of the main categories of Dorian Theatre Awards, given annually to the best production of a new Off-Broadway musical or play by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association). The category was introduced in 2023 when the awards began honoring Broadway theatre.
